The '''Th'irus system''' was located within [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Th'irus]], home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Th'iruckai]].<ref name="GMS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Th'irus system was based on the planet Th'irus, created by the ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen]]''; however, in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', it was spelt "Thi'rus." This misspelling later corrected in an update to the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].
